component.name: Rivet
component.summary: Fedora updates in one place, with the risky ones flagged

description.p: Rivet replaces GNOME Software for updates. It shows every pending dnf, Flatpak and firmware update in one list, says in one line what each one does, and colours it green, yellow or red so you know which ones to read before you click. It also keeps an eye on the software GNOME Software never sees.

ul.li: One list for dnf, Flatpak and fwupd, checked hourly by a user timer, with a top-bar badge when something is waiting
Each update rated by fixed rules (security advisories, kernel, drivers, runtimes), with a short plain reason
Kernel plus NVIDIA akmod updates wait for the module to build and verify it before a reboot is offered
Flatpak runtime updates are held while Steam is running; a pinned Flatpak can be tried again and rolled back
Other software: stale npm, pipx, uv and cargo tools, GNOME extensions, AppImages, containers and Home Assistant
When a run fails, Fix it asks Claude Code (if installed) to read the logs and propose a fix you approve step by step

description.p: Not affiliated with Fedora, GNOME or Home Assistant.

screenshot.caption: Pending updates, each with a colour and a one-line reason

description.p: A newer Fedora release appears as one unticked row and is downloaded last. The list is re-checked after an install and after a boot. Held back moves to the bottom.
